tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum rgya mtshor sman mchod 'bul ba'i tshul bdud rtsi'i sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru de wā ḍa ki nī ga ṇe bhyaḥ

'dir rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ bka' gter gyi gzhung so so'i sman mchod kyi rjes su 'di ltar sbyar ro/ kun bzang rdor 'chang rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho/ /grags chen gsal ba'i ston pa bcu gnyis sogs/ /mkha' khyab rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo byin rlabs dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /gsang bdag dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī siṃ/ /dzñā na sū tra mkhas pa nyer gcig sogs/ /sems klong man ngag brda brgyud bla ma la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo= oṃ sarba= /rigs gsum sems dpa' rigs can drwa ma lnga/ /rgyal po dzaḥdang bde ba gsal mdzad sogs/ /rjes su rnal 'byor tshom bu 'bum phrag la/ /sman mchod= oṃ sarba = sgeg pa rdo rje sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ /las kyi dbang mo rig 'dzin rnam brgyad sogs/ /rgyud dang sgrub sde'i shing rta che rnams la/ /sman mchod= oṃ sarba= /bya spyod rnal 'byor rig sngags grub pa dang*/ /'dzam gling rgyan mchog rmad byung slob mar bcas/ /thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me mchog rnams la/ /sman mchod= oṃ sarba= /rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag thod phreng rtsal/ /mtshan mchog brgyad dang rnam 'phrul bcu gnyis sogs/ /bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lo la/ /sman mchod= oṃ sarba= /dri med bshes gnyen mkhan chen byang chub sems/ /chos rgyal yab sras bai ro mtsho rgyal sogs/ /sprul pa'i rje 'bangs lo paṇa tshogs rnams la/ /sman mchod= oṃ sarba= /so zur gnubs nyang gter ston rgya mtshor bcas/ /bka' gter dag snang chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ dus gsum mkhas grub rim par byon rnams la/ /sman mchod= oṃ sarba= /khyad par skyabs kun 'dus zhal ye shes sku/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor bshes gnyen mchog gi tshul/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /sman mchod= oṃ sarba= /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dus pa sgyu 'phrul lha/

/khrag 'thung dpal dgu rigs lnga rigs gsum sogs/ /rgyud sde drug gi yi dam lha tshogs la/ /sman mchod= oṃ sarba= /lung rtogs dam pa'i chos kyi ngo bo nyid/ /phyogs dus rgyal dang de sras slob mar bcas/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin chen por/ /sman mchod= oṃ sarba= /gnas gsum dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje'i chos srung nor lha gter gyi bdag /'khor 'das dbyer med rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo byin rlabs dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes 'bul/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: mtheb srin nyi zla'i ga'u sbyar ba yis/ lha tshogs dngos grub bdud rtsi'i 'bru gsum po/ blangs te rdo rje lce yi hūm̐ las brgyud/ lus kun gang bas ye shes rgyas par gyur/ kā ya siddhi oṃ: wā' ka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhihūm̐: zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi'i thig le gnas gsum du reg pa'i mthar rdo rje'i lces myong bas dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad thob cing brtan par bsam mo/ /zhes pa'ang bka' gter gyi phrin las spyi la sbyar chog pa'i dbang du byas te mtsho skyes bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa sarba siddhi puṣtiṃ bha ba tu/ //
